given: The home stock table is showing filed records with their quantities
then: The quantity column values are right-aligned rather than left- or default-aligned
architectural_notes: E2E, presentation-only slice owned entirely in the React SPA (client/ components/pages), not the API boundary: the numeric-column right-alignment is a rendering concern, so no business logic and no boundary/service change is implied. Owner module: the client stock-table component's quantity column. Covered by the client Vitest/Playwright harness (NFR-F1-spa-json-boundary) rather than the branch integration suite, since the DB and service contract are unchanged from AC1.

rationale: Asserts the presentation of the quantity column (right-aligned), a distinct observable outcome from AC1 which asserts only that the correct SKU/location/quantity values appear; a build could list every row with correct data yet left-align the quantities.
